run: claude_code --cc-model claude-opus-5-5, T1, --verif-level V1, oracle interview, no hardware approval
verdict: First Claude Code run past stage 2 (passed at V1 in one repair visit). Stopped at stage 3 (5 visits): every Vivado build failed in 2 s with 'Failed to connect to bus: No medium found' (run_vivado.sh uses systemd-run --user; this process's environment lacked the user bus variables). Cause: HARNESS/ENVIRONMENT, not the model (board_constraints worked, its mapping error 'DP used by both seg[7] and dp' was corrected by the model in one turn). Fixed: the runner supplies XDG_RUNTIME_DIR / DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS when missing.
